description: This file contains implementations related to Content Decryption Module (CDM) interactions, including classes for managing content decryption (OCDMImplementation), creating and handling DRM sessions, parsing content types, and interfacing with external DRM system factories. It also includes initialization and deinitialization logic for the DRM system, support checking for key systems and content types, and registry management for different DRM types and their blacklists.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing content decryption, DRM system management, session creation, and support checks.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: Class enabling RPC communication with external content decryption services.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Class providing access to DRM functionalities, creating sessions, and managing supported key systems.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration structure parsed from JSON, defining key systems, blacklists, and system settings.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM system, loads DRM factories, registers systems, and sets up RPC services.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up frameworks and factories during shutdown.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Retrieves the media key system interface for a given key system string.

methods.name: Systems
methods.description: Provides an iterator over supported key system names.

methods.name: Designators
methods.description: Provides an iterator over designators (identifiers) for a specific key system.

methods.name: Sessions
methods.description: Provides an iterator over active session identifiers for a specific key system.
